subject.title: Feishu: card fails with 'table number over limit' — should fallback or render tables as images

question: Should maintainers accept the linked PR's preflight fallback approach as the intended Feishu table-limit fix, and should streaming CardKit be included or tracked separately?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and has an open proof-positive PR, but that PR is conflicting and explicitly excludes streaming CardKit while this issue mentions streaming startup failures too.

options.title: Rebase and review current PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86901 as the landing path for static interactive-card fallback, then decide whether streaming needs a follow-up.

options.title: Close the PR and replace it
options.body: Open a new narrow maintainer-owned fix if the existing PR cannot be rebased cleanly or does not match the desired fallback shape.

options.title: Broaden scope before landing
options.body: Require the same PR or a coordinated pair of PRs to prove both static interactive cards and streaming CardKit behavior before closing this issue.

recommendation.title: Rebase and review current PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86901 as the landing path for static interactive-card fallback, then decide whether streaming needs a follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu plugin docs and package metadata identify this handle as the community-maintained plugin contact, making them the best routing owner for the channel-specific behavior decision.
